in_hebrew.name: Marrissa
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marrissa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Mariamne,' meaning 'rebellious,' 'bitter,' or 'marine.' This name was borne by a heroine in the New Testament who was the wife of Judas Iscariot and was ultimately beheaded for her faith.
